text: `tools/pilot/trace-proxy.mjs` `startProxy` writes each provider request body to `NNN.req.json` and the raw response stream to `NNN.res.txt` under the run's out dir; headers are never logged. `tools/pilot/run-session.mjs` points the session's provider `baseUrl` at this proxy through a rewritten `models.json`.

Release metadata lives in `package.json`, `update-manifest.json`, and `CHANGELOG.md`. The CI job `release-metadata` requires the manifest package and version to match `package.json` and requires a `## [version]` section in CHANGELOG.md. The manifest uses source `git:github.com/cloverinternational/trebol@main` and updateCommand `pi update --extensions`.
`keyEffect` in `.pi/lib/tern/keys.ts` maps one complete terminal sequence using pi-tui `parseKey` and `decodeKittyPrintable`, so Kitty CSI-u printable keys are not read byte-by-byte as Escape.

Task-gate hooks stay dormant for the first `HOOK_WARMUP_TURNS` (5) turns of a session. The recorded `tools/e2e/memory-gate.mjs` run shows `search` and `get` allowed and `remember` blocked with the exemption, and all three blocked with it reverted.
Adding code indexing raised dev dense hit@10 from 5/12 to 9/12 in the memory-audit ablation.

text: The memory-history `before_agent_start` hook appends the `<memory_workflow>` guidance last in the system prompt, and it covers each new substantive project task or question, not only tasks.

text: TaskManage file evidence resolves against `workspaceRoot`, linked worktrees, and `evidenceRoots`, which are host-owned options that task input cannot set. Evidence outside these roots fails with reason `outside_allowed_roots`, and that message does not name the resolution root.
verdict: partly: "message does not name the root" not shown

text: Tern plugins are folders whose `plugin.toml` names `host.luau` and `window.luau` as their two halves, as in `tern-plugins/code-puppy/plugin.toml`. The stencil-hq SDK repo and `plugins/tern.d.luau` are not verified in this repository.

`#selectModel` in `.pi/lib/tern/bridge.ts` returns early with "model selection unavailable in this Pi session" when `session.modelRuntime` or `session.setModel` is missing. It loads the catalog with `getAvailableSnapshot()`, then refreshes it with `getAvailable()` when present.

Path-only answers stay `candidate` with the `evidence-unanchored` tag and are not recalled. Verified records drop out as stale when a cited span is edited, but editing an uncited line keeps them verified.
The running-work drawer shows bash items as one-line previews via `runningWorkListLabel` (control characters stripped, default 36-char limit), while non-bash items keep `kind label` form.

`npm run check:install` runs `tools/install/check-load.mjs` with isolated temporary settings; it loads the package without starting a session or invoking a model, executes extension factories, and does not certify individual tools or real-user resource filters.

The pool takes the top 10 from each of 7 arms (rg, memory, dense_v1, rrf_v1, dense_v2, bm25_v2, rrf_v2) for each query, yielding 1485 unique (query, doc) pairs over 42 queries, split into judge-batch-0..5 and judged in judgments-A and judgments-B.
verdict: partly: 1485 pairs/42 queries not in span

text: Tern keeps composer draft state in `PiTernBridge` as the `#draft` accessor (get/set), and editing is done by `DraftEditor`, which tracks UTF-16 `text`/`cursor`/`selection`. Composer nodes are built by `composerNodes` in `.pi/lib/tern/composer-view.ts`, which the bridge calls with `draft: this.#draft`.

Per-answer memory records are written by `captureTaskCandidates` only for completed tasks: kind `fact`, id `answerId(session,task,question)`, source `taskmanage-answer:<session>:<task>:<question>`, tags `taskmanage-answer` plus `evidence-anchored` or `evidence-unanchored`. Text is `Q:`/`A:`/`Task:` lines, plus an `Unresolved evidence:` line when any ref fails.

`tools/e2e/project-context.mjs` runs real Pi with the `project_context` extension and checks that a valid token returns the gate-exemption fact at the top hit, and that a wrong token fails with Agent-MCP's Unauthorized.
The repository declares the Agent-MCP submodule `vendor/agent-mcp`, sourced from `https://github.com/rinadelph/Agent-MCP.git`, in `.gitmodules`.
